messages:
violet_marketing: final briefing for tomorrow's launch — need one short changelog, docs permalink, benchmark story link, webinar CTA, and inbound routing mapping.
elaine_pm: scope is perf + streaming only. i'll post two-line changelog now.
tyler_eng: canary scheduled 08:00 PST, 15m canary + 30m observe. marketing hold public posts till 08:50 PST.
sophia_docs: assembling docs bundle (migration note, examples, minimal how-to). will publish prod permalink after deploy. staging: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/2-1-preview
omar_ops: i'll enable HubSpot webhook after deploy success. need the tag name from marketing.
cassie_sdr: routing request: enterprise -> SDR-Gamma, free trials -> nurture flow. want demo signup webhook to #sales-inbound.
violet_marketing: tag: `autumn-launch-2-1`. changelog draft: - ~15% lower per-token cost on typical embedding workloads; - streaming reliability fixes for long chats. impact line: "Lower cost and steadier streaming make scaling inference smoother."
tyler_eng: confirm 15% is for our common embedding profile; include "typical workloads" qualifier.
sophia_docs: prod docs permalink once live: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/guide — will include migration snippet and quick curl demo. benchmark gist: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/rel-2-1-benchmarks
violet_marketing: webinar confirmation needs docs permalink, slides, demo notebook, and 1-line changelog. sophia, please add a curl snippet for the email.
sophia_docs: added `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"demo"}'` to the slides. uploading now.
omar_ops: webhook prepared: https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/launch-2-1; enabling post-success.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 08:00 PST. Will post updates to #release-war-room.
tyler_eng: monitoring rule: if p99 latency > baseline +20% or errors spike, pause and notify here.
deploy-bot: Canary success at 08:12 PST. Observability hold until 08:42 PST. Event payload sample: {"event":"release","version":"2.1","status":"canary-success"}
violet_marketing: scheduling social + email for 08:50 PST. will wait the hold. please flag here if any telemetry looks off.
cassie_sdr: HubSpot workflow updated and webhook tested; routing live.
elaine_pm: quick QA: confirm docs link in registration email is https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1/guide
sophia_docs: confirmed.
violet_marketing: thanks team — i'll post social drafts for a quick PR in 10m and hold for rollback signals. :rocket:
